//: EXAMPLE pack - shape reference only, no real values. Committed.
A pack is reusable vocabulary: the terms that are the same across every
project at one employer. Real packs go in config/packs/*.local.json,
which is gitignored, or are produced by tools/harvest-vocab.js.
Reference packs from your claudefuscator.local.json:
{ "packs": ["config/packs/mine.local.json"], "identifiers": [...] }
Project identifiers are applied LAST, so they override a pack.
THE THREE LAYERS
generic      built-in regex patterns (email, privateIp, mac,
internalHost). No vocabulary, applies anywhere.
packs        this file - org/product/process vocabulary.
identifiers  the project's own list. Wins over both.
allowList    never-tokenize words. Wins over everything.
COST OF OVER-TOKENIZING: every term you add is a term Claude can no
longer reason about. Tokenizing a whole domain vocabulary buys little
and costs a lot of answer quality. Add what is genuinely identifying.

identifiers.//: Plain org name. Case-insensitive, aliases collapse to one token.

//: Process acronym. caseSensitive so the lowercase word is untouched -
short acronyms collide with ordinary words constantly.
Think twice: if Claude cannot see what process you mean, it cannot
help you with it.
compound: matches INSIDE a code identifier, so ExampleCorp hits in
ExampleCorpClient and EXAMPLECORP_TIMEOUT.
compound implies caseSensitive, and each spelling gets its OWN token,
so code round-trips byte-exact instead of being case-folded.
List every spelling you want matched - unlisted ones are left alone.
This renames a LABEL inside code. It does NOT hide what the code
does; see CLAUDE.md on the scope boundary.
